name: live_aggressive
description: Kids. Suggestive + explicit intimate classes at low thresholds; cover the WHOLE picture (+pad) on any hit; UNSURE is covered too (fail closed) and gets a rate-limited second look that may clear it; PENDING (not classified yet) pictures are pre-frosted ('blur until safe', prefrost.mode = always).

notes.score_on: 0.25 ~ the old strict/balanced live floors (0.22 / 0.30); kids mode prefers over-blur.
notes.score_unsure: 0.15..0.25 is UNSURE: masked now, second look (2x tiles) may clear it.
notes.class_score_on: Shirtless men / bare bellies (beach, sport) are the common false hits; nudged up a little.
notes.explicit_style: Pictures with an EXPLICIT class hit use the opaque cover instead of frost.
notes.never: FACE_* / FEET_* / ARMPITS_* / BELLY_COVERED never count (vision_core.nudenet_labels.NEVER_MASK_CLASSES).
notes.clipped_fail_closed: A picture cut by the frame / a pane edge that has never been seen whole is covered (CLIPPED_UNVERIFIED) until it is fully on screen and checked; one seen whole before keeps that verdict while it scrolls out.
notes.clipped_release: Bounds the clipped cover: once a clipped picture has not moved for 3 calls, its visible part was checked SAFE, and that part is large (h >= 0.5 w, or >= 30% of the content height), the cover is released. Slivers and pictures still scrolling in stay covered.
notes.prefrost: always (for now): every not-yet-checked picture is pre-frosted until classified ('blur until safe'). Switch to "adaptive" to pre-frost only on heavy pages.
